stories.name: Intel Turnaround Rally
stories.blurb: Intel's stock and analyst sentiment have been rallying on optimism that its turnaround strategy and AI-driven demand are gaining traction ahead of and following Q2 earnings.

stories.name: AI Chip Selloff
stories.blurb: A broad global selloff in AI and semiconductor stocks, driven by fading enthusiasm for AI trade and weak guidance, has pushed the Nasdaq into correction.

stories.name: Intel Ohio fab partnership
stories.blurb: Intel is seeking operating partners, including SK Hynix, for its Ohio chip fab while continuing work on Elon Musk's Terafab venture.

stories.name: AMD Stock Surge
stories.blurb: AMD's stock has crossed $1 trillion amid growing AI optimism, a Microsoft partnership, and debate over whether it remains a good buy.

stories.name: AI Chip Market Growth
stories.blurb: A collection of market reports highlighting how AI, 5G, and edge computing are driving rapid growth across semiconductors, chipsets, and related hardware markets where Intel competes.

stories.name: AI chip stock rally
stories.blurb: Investors are debating whether the surging valuations of AI chipmakers like NVIDIA and Marvell are justified by future growth or due for a pullback.

stories.name: ASML AI chip demand
stories.blurb: ASML is ramping up EUV lithography production and attracting investor attention as surging AI chip demand drives competition among major semiconductor players.

past.name: Intel-SK Hynix Ohio Deal
past.blurb: Intel is reportedly in talks with SK Hynix to manufacture memory chips at Intel's underused Ohio fab, boosting Intel's stock alongside a separate $15 billion capital raise for AI chip growth.

past.name: AI chip selloff
past.blurb: A broad selloff in AI-related chip and memory stocks, driven by bubble fears and weak guidance, is dragging down markets worldwide.

past.name: Meta Muse AI Chip Rally
past.blurb: Meta's new Muse AI agent sparked expectations of increased CPU demand, sending Intel, AMD, and Arm shares sharply higher amid broader moves in the AI chip sector.

past.name: Apple Ditching Qualcomm
past.blurb: Apple is gradually replacing Qualcomm's modem chips with its own in-house designs, raising questions about Qualcomm's future revenue and stock performance.

7.text: Intel is expected to report Q3 2026 earnings on October 29, with forecasts of $0.39 EPS (up 69.6%) and $16.44 billion revenue (up 20.4%). The stock has fallen roughly 15–17% over the past month despite an analyst upgrade and strong prior beats, with volatile post-earnings swings.

5.text: Chip stocks fell for eight straight sessions on AI-spending and supply-chain worries, then rebounded Monday and Tuesday before dropping again Thursday after Lam Research cited supply constraints. Intel is not mentioned in any of these articles.

15.text: Intel is partnering with Tesla and SpaceX on Musk’s Terafab AI chip project, a proposed $16.8 billion effort targeting 100,000 chips monthly, with analyst speculation it could threaten TSMC. Separately, Intel’s $28 billion Ohio fab slipped to 2030–2031, Fab 62 targets late 2028, and JPMorgan upgraded the stock.

11.text: AMD has surged roughly 137–150% in 2026 on AI data center chip demand, with hyperscaler deals, gigawatt-scale AI accelerator commitments, and a 50% revenue jump, though the stock fell sharply in recent weeks. Intel appears only as a comparison point in the CPU market, where one article calls the comeback a two-stock fight and favors AMD.

13.text: Research and Markets reports project growth in photonic ICs, wafer foundry services, silicon wafers, industrial semiconductors, FinFET transistors, and EUV lithography, naming Intel among key players in several. Intel is cited as a competitor in these markets but no Intel-specific developments are reported.

12.text: ASML reported record Q3 2026 results with 56% revenue growth and orders extending to 2030, while TSMC, ASE, and Cadence also posted strong AI-driven results. Intel is not mentioned; the articles bear on it only as broader evidence of AI chip demand.
